entries.name: Nigerian Independence Day
entries.capsule: Marks Nigeria's independence on Oct. 1, 1960; Minnesota's Nigerian umbrella group holds an Independence celebration each October.

dates.source: Fixed date; Gov. Mark Dayton's 2014 proclamation names Oct. 1 as the anniversary of Nigerian independence

entries.whatItMarks: Nigeria's independence from Britain in 1960 (the 2014 proclamation marked the 54th anniversary).
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The Minnesota Institute for Nigerian Development lists an 'Independence Celebration in October' among its yearly events; no date or place for 2026 was published on the pages opened. Gov. Mark Dayton proclaimed Oct. 1, 2014, Nigerian Independence Day in Minnesota.

minnesotaEvents.organizerDates: October each year; 2026 date not published

entries.name: IgboFest
alsoKnownAs: Igbo Day (when proclaimed by the governor)
entries.capsule: Free festival of Igbo culture in Brooklyn Park, held each August since 1994 by the Umunne Cultural Association.
entries.dateRule: Announced each year by the Umunne Cultural Association; a Saturday in August.

dates.source: North Hennepin Community College; CCX Media; Minneapolis Northwest Tourism
No announcement found
No announcement found

entries.whatItMarks: Igbo culture and heritage; the 2026 festival was the 31st.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Held on the grounds of North Hennepin Community College, Brooklyn Park, 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. in 2026, with masquerades, dances by children and women, clothing and bead vendors and Igbo food; free. Governors proclaimed the festival Saturday as Igbo Day in 2016, 2019 and 2022.

minnesotaEvents.name: 31st annual IgboFest
minnesotaEvents.place: North Hennepin Community College, 7411 85th Ave. N., Brooklyn Park

sources.title: IgboFest Returns To Brooklyn Park Aug. 8, CCX Media (July 31, 2026)

entries.name: IgboFest Gala Night
entries.capsule: Evening gala on the eve of IgboFest, with guests in traditional Igbo attire; it has included the Ada Igbo pageant.
entries.dateRule: Announced each year; the Friday before IgboFest.

dates.source: Minneapolis Northwest Tourism; Sahan Journal

entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: In 2026 at the Brooklyn Park Activity Center, 5600 85th Ave. N., with guests invited to wear traditional Igbo attire. In 2022 the gala was held at Banquets of Minnesota and included the Ada Igbo beauty pageant.
